# Copilot instructions

Follow the canonical [repository guidance](../AGENTS.md) and the linked Mivu
product plan, design system, and CI/delivery contract. Keep Swift changes small,
native, privacy-preserving, and accessible. Preserve English-first sample mode,
profile isolation, durable capture, explicit backup acknowledgement, and deletion
guards. Use synthetic data only. Report named test and source evidence honestly;
do not infer hosted CI or release success from workflow files. Never expose
credentials or claim remote backup sync from a local file-provider write.
